people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: “Because the leaders took the lead in Israel, because the people offered themselves willingly, be blessed, Yahweh!
translations.bsb: “When the princes take the lead in Israel, when the people volunteer, bless the LORD.
translations.kjv: Praise ye the LORD for the avenging of Israel, when the people willingly offered
translations.asv: For that the leaders took the lead in Israel, For that the people offered themselves willingly, Bless ye Jehovah.
